fix: Move @aws-sdk/client-s3 from devDependencies to dependencies so Open.s3_v3 (and bundlers that statically resolve lib/Open/index.js) can find it after a normal install.
credit: @zachstence (PR #331 author; Co-authored-by in the fork commit)
changes: package.json: added "@aws-sdk/client-s3": "^3.620.0" to dependencies; removed it from devDependencies. No source changes.
Trade-off: installing unzipper now also installs the AWS SDK v3 S3 client (and its dependencies).
verification: Clean production install (no devDependencies): require.resolve('@aws-sdk/client-s3') from unzipper succeeds and unzipper.Open.s3_v3 reads a zip through a mocked S3 client; with upstream 0.12.5 it fails with "Cannot find module '@aws-sdk/client-s3'".
